name: com.atommerce.maca_android_sdk.ui.view.main.view.MainActivity
description: The Mindcafe Android SDK from Atommerce uses this as its main screen for the home page, counselor search, counseling, and My Space. It also opens counseling sessions and related pages when the SDK routes the user there.
disableEffect: Without it, users cannot enter these main Mindcafe areas or follow the SDK counseling routes.
